parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the scroll wheel of a computer mouse, typically made of rubber for grip and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to scroll vertically or horizontally through content on a screen.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when scrolled by the user's finger.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is another view of the scroll wheel of the mouse, made of rubber for tactile feedback.
parts.Functional_description: It performs the same scrolling function, enabling smooth navigation through digital content.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates smoothly along its axis when manipulated by the user.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the computer mouse, made of durable ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal components, provides structural support, and serves as the main surface for hand contact.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to its internal components but moves as a whole across a surface when used.
